text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: auto-rollback recommended for release v4.0.0 (embedding-service). reason=routing-error-surge. rerank_misorder_pct 5m=4.9% (auto-rollback threshold=4.0%). suggested_action=auto-rollback to v3.9.8 unless human override within 3m.

sara: I'm here. what's the customer impact? any 5xxs or just score drift?

deploy-bot: customer-visible errors=0. score-stability metric shows degradation for similarity scores causing downstream rerank misorders. no p95 latency spike.

josh: rerank misorders can break recommendation UX. however auto-revert now might trigger capacity ripple for dedicated pools. need a quick root-cause check.

priya: pulling trace samples. initial look: token-shard sequencing occasionally returns empty embeddings for short inputs on gpu-1. approximate failure rate 0.7% overall but concentrated on a heavy tenant slice.

nina: which tenant? could be a dedicated customer causing skew.

priya: tenant=acme-markets (dedicated pool id dp-22). 4 of top 7 misorders trace back to ACME traffic.

release-coordinator: note: we have a change window until 1800000000. auto-rollback will run and might affect other tenants. recommend manual hold & targeted rollback only for dp-22 or model variant.

josh: agree. partial rollback to v3.9.8 for dp-22 seems safest. how fast can we execute?

ci-bot: command available: `rbctl rollback-slice --env=prod --slice=dp-22 --to=3.9.8 --reason="rerank-misorder"`

sara: run it and paste confirmation. also add a brief customer message to ACME account team and support.

josh: executing now...

ci-bot: workflow triggered by josh at 1779992265: rollback-slice (dp-22 -> 3.9.8).

ci-bot: rollback succeeded. id=rb-1779992265, affected_slices=["dp-22"], start_ts=1779992267, done_ts=1779992275.

priya: rollback confirms dp-22 traffic now on 3.9.8. monitoring sampling traces for rerank_misorder_pct on dp-22.

nina: support: notifying ACME account team now. cc @sara @josh.

sara: sent note: "We've applied a targeted rollback for your dedicated pool to mitigate similarity misorders. Investigating root cause; will follow up within 90 minutes. If you notice regression, reply to this thread."

release-coordinator: updating release notes: append: "temporary targeted rollback for dp-22 due to embedding instability; ongoing investigation INF-4490."

josh: opened INF-4490 with traces and rollout logs: https://issues.redwood.ai/INF-4490

priya: after rollback dp-22 rerank_misorder_pct dropped from 4.9% -> 0.6% within two minutes. other tenants unaffected.

sara: great. decision: targeted rollback executed, no global revert. next steps: 1) reproduce locally on failing commit 4.0.0 branch, 2) instrument tokenizer shard sequencing more defensively, 3) prepare a patch and staged rollout.

nina: scheduling a customer-facing follow-up in #customer-notify for affected customers only; approved.

release-coordinator: also flag this for postmortem if a hotfix isn't deployed within 6 hours. add owners: josh (exec), priya (investigation), nina (cust comms).

ci-bot: created postmortem task PM-177999 at https://tasks.redwood.ai/PM-177999 and linked INF-4490.

priya: note: we suppressed auto-rollback because of dedicated-pool risk and decided targeted rollback. filing a quick runbook note: `if rerank_misorder_pct > 4% AND failures concentrated to dedicated pool -> prefer rollback-slice vs global`

josh: copying runbook snippet to ops-runbook repo.

sara: leaving thread open for 90m; will unpin once metrics stable and patch in staging. thanks everyone. :v:
